observation: Workflow orchestration reconstructed voku/agent-session CLI argument lists and injected CLI runners even though agent-session already exposed typed SessionStore and WorkBriefStore APIs. Replacing those internal process-shaped boundaries with direct PHP calls removed workflow-specific argv/default/path knowledge from Dispatcher and reduced the production diff by 33 net lines while preserving the public session CLI namespace.

evidence.summary: PR #28 passed PHPUnit and PHPStan on PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 after START, PLAN, APPROVE, and CLOSE were moved to typed package APIs. The installed release-set lifecycle also remained green.

hypothesis: Internal PHP-to-PHP orchestration through focused-package CLIs duplicates transport knowledge and creates accidental process boundaries that are harder to type, test, and evolve than the package's existing application API.
validated_conclusion: Inside agent-loop workflow orchestration, call focused-package typed PHP APIs when they exist. Keep CLI delegation at genuine user-facing command boundaries, not between PHP components in the same process.
